messages.en: Has that real estate agent replied to you yet? I'd like to view the house tomorrow.
Yes. The agent said we can only come at ten.
Is the power back on at your place yet?
Yeah, it just came back on. The fan's running too.
This phone still works fine. No need to replace it.
You've got a point. I'll just replace the battery for now.
Have you eaten yet, Mum? I'm about to buy some food at this shop.
Not yet. Just get me a portion of chicken rice, okay?
